nodes.description: OG.totalSupply: private counter of minted tokens, incremented in mint() and used as token id source.
OG._royaltiesReceiver: private address that receives ERC-2981 royalty payments; settable by owner.
ERC721.mintingActive: public boolean gate that controls whether public minting is enabled.
OG.artBalance: mapping(address => uint) tracking how many tokens each minter holds.
ERC721URIStorage._ogs: mapping(uint256 => uint256) storing the years-in-crypto value that drives on-chain art generation.
OG.MAX_SUPPLY: constant maximum number of mintable tokens (10); declared but not enforced in mint().
OG.royaltiesPercentage: constant royalty percentage (10) used in royaltyInfo calculations.
OG.mint(uint256 noYears) external payable: charges at least 0.01 ETH, safe-mints a new token to msg.sender, stores noYears and increments counters.
OG.withdraw(uint amount) onlyOwner: transfers contract balance to msg.sender via payable.transfer.
OG.setRoyaltiesReceiver(address) external onlyOwner: updates the royalty recipient address.
OG.setMintingActive(bool) public onlyOwner: toggles the mintingActive state variable.
OG.royaltyInfo(uint256,uint256) external view: returns the royalties receiver and the royalty amount for a sale price.
ERC721URIStorage.getCurrentYear() public view: derives the current year from block.timestamp; time-dependent art generation input.
ERC721URIStorage.makeArt(uint256) public view: builds the on-chain SVG artwork from the stored OG value and the current year.
OG/ERC721URIStorage.tokenURI(uint256) public view: builds the base64 JSON+SVG metadata, calling makeArt and the stored _ogs value.
ERC721URIStorage._setOGs(uint256,uint256) internal: writes the years-in-crypto value for a token id.
ERC721URIStorage.timestamp2year(uint256) public pure: converts a UNIX timestamp into a year, used with block.timestamp.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used as mint recipient, payment source and withdrawal recipient.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time value used by getCurrentYear/timestamp2year to derive the art year.
tx.origin: externally controlled origin address; relevant to the Ownable/onlyOwner authorization pattern used across the contract.
payable(someone).transfer(amount): external value transfer to an attacker-influenced address inside withdraw().
_safeMint(msg.sender, totalSupply+1): minting operation that may invoke IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received callback on contract recipients.
Parameter noYears of mint(uint256 noYears): number of years of crypto involvement stored as the OG badge value.
Parameter amount of withdraw(uint amount): amount of wei transferred to the owner.
Parameter tokenId of tokenURI(uint256): token whose metadata is being rendered.
Parameter _tokenId of royaltyInfo(uint256,uint256): NFT asset queried for royalty information.
Parameter _salePrice of royaltyInfo(uint256,uint256): sale price used to compute the royalty amount.
Parameter newRoyaltiesReceiver of setRoyaltiesReceiver(address): new royalty payout address, owner-restricted.
Parameter tokenId of _setOGs(uint256,uint256): token whose OG value is being written.
Parameter _ogsPassed of _setOGs(uint256,uint256): years-in-crypto value stored in the _ogs mapping.
Local variable someone in withdraw(): aliases msg.sender as the transfer recipient.
Local variable _royalties in royaltyInfo(): computed royalty amount from sale price and percentage.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient and as the sender of the mint payment.
mintingActive gates whether mint() can be executed by a non-owner caller.
mint() increments totalSupply after minting the new token id.
mint() increments artBalance for msg.sender, recording the minter's holdings.
mint() calls _safeMint as its minting primitive.
msg.sender is passed as the recipient of the safe minted token.
totalSupply+1 supplies the token id used in the safe mint call.
mint() calls _setOGs to persist the years-in-crypto value for the new token.
_setOGs writes the supplied value into the _ogs mapping.
withdraw() performs an external value transfer to the caller, the classic value-call sink.
withdraw() is restricted by onlyOwner, which compares owner() against msg.sender.
The amount parameter is validated against the contract balance and forwarded to the transfer.
The local recipient alias is used as the target of the external value transfer.
msg.sender ultimately controls the address receiving the ETH transfer.
block.timestamp is the only entropy source for deriving the current year in getCurrentYear().
block.timestamp is passed into timestamp2year, making year computation timestamp dependent.
getCurrentYear() invokes timestamp2year on the current block time.
The derived current year feeds the artwork generation in makeArt().
tokenURI() calls makeArt() to render the on-chain SVG for the token.
The stored _ogs value determines the number of years rendered in the art.
royaltiesPercentage is multiplied with the sale price inside royaltyInfo().
The royalties receiver state variable is returned by royaltyInfo().
The queried token id parameter is taken by royaltyInfo().
The sale price parameter drives the royalty amount computation.
royaltyInfo() derives the local royalty amount from sale price and percentage.
setRoyaltiesReceiver() is owner-restricted and takes the new receiver as an argument.
setRoyaltiesReceiver() overwrites the royalties receiver state variable.
The noYears argument supplied by the minter becomes the token's stored OG value.
The token id parameter selects the mapping slot written by _setOGs.
The passed OG value is the payload written into the _ogs mapping.
The tokenId parameter selects which token metadata tokenURI() renders.
setMintingActive() is owner-only and mutates the minting gate variable.
tokenURI() reads the stored _ogs value to build the traits and artwork.
The safe mint can invoke onERC721Received on a contract recipient, re-entering deployer-controlled code during mint().
